name: io.github.vulinh1704/spend-guard
title: Spend Guard
description: Budgets, payee allowlists, price-spike checks and human approval for agents paying x402 paywalls

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Policy JSON file: networks, budgets, approval amount, spike ratio, known services and their payees. Without one, every payment waits for your approval.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_RAILS
environmentVariables.description: How to pay: mock (pays nothing), near, near-guard, arc, gateway, or a comma list with one rail per network. arc and gateway need ARC_PRIVATE_KEY, near needs NEAR_ACCOUNT_ID and NEAR_PRIVATE_KEY, near-guard needs NEAR_GUARD_ID and NEAR_GUARD_AGENT_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Decisions file, read back on start so a restart keeps today's spend; servers on one file share one budget. Default ~/.spend-guard/ledger.jsonl; off keeps it in memory.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_DASHBOARD_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the approval dashboard on 127.0.0.1. 0 picks a free one; off means no dashboard, and payments that need approval are declined.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds a payment waits for your answer before it is declined. Raise it together with your client's tool timeout.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_GUARD_MOCK_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Network the mock rail pretends to pay on.

environmentVariables.name: ARC_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key for the arc and gateway rails. Testnet keys only.

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent account for the near rail (testnet).

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key for the near rail. Testnet keys only.

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_GUARD_ID
environmentVariables.description: The guard contract's account for the near-guard rail (testnet). It holds the agent's NEAR.

environmentVariables.name: NEAR_GUARD_AGENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The agent's function-call key on the guard contract's account, which may only call pay(). Testnet keys only.
